g.text: Hey Quincy, I know you're not a huge fan of Amir and all, but... I have a favor to ask.
So if I needed to bribe you into doing something for me, how much would it cost?
lol how can i tell u what it costs if i dunno what u want?
Okay, so... wait to hear me out before you make up your mind, ok? So...there's this game.
So, Amir's trying to get the gang together to play this tabletop roleplaying game.
I think it's a fun excuse to get everybody together and hang out.
It's an excuse to chill, lay low, and maybe drink a few beers.
Morale's low with the team, with everything going on.
i get me plenty of quality time with all u every damn day lol. we all stuck here in case u forgot lmao. so sorry, u yutes have fun
So... it's a really dorky board game. Like *really dorky.*
sounds like a u problem, i'm fking fine lmao
like how dorky r we talking?
"Rolling dice and pretending to be mages," dorky.
Hear me out. It's called Fables & Frontiers.
LMAOOO!! take a look at me m8, do i look like the type 2 wanna do that?
You'll have to roll dice. But you don't have to do a voice or anything silly.
I'm trying not to judge a protoframe by its cover.
No... but... I can make it worth your while?
And you can make fun of it in your head the entire time.
bribing me 2 play some stupid game?! ur seriously mental
hmmmmm.... u using ur eyes lately? look around
appreciate that, but i got real grown up shit 2 do, gonna have 2 take a pass
money not good 4 much, n u know that. so if u want me 2 play this silly game with u yutes? ur gunna have to make it somethin' interesting lol. like a favour
nope. sry. u yutes have fun. lol
nature tbd, to be collected at a time and place of my choosin', read me?
I... don't think I like the idea of owing you a favor. Not over this. Never mind.
tho. now i gotta do this stupid game, don't i? shit
not sure who just played who lol
don't forget about that favour, tho
